description: tonyd2wild's boot-fixed jasl sparkrun recipe for the original DeepSeek-V4-Flash on two Sparks: vLLM tensor parallel 2 on scitrera's public jasl-ds4 image (vLLM 0.22.1-jasl-ds4+21a54ea, tag 20260609, digest-pinned, used unmodified), FP8 KV cache, DeepSeek MTP with two drafted tokens, instanttensor loading, a 256,000-token context and jasl's sparse-MLA long-context chunk profile. Upstream states this is a boot fix, not a performance upgrade: it did not beat aidendle94's production-ready image on decode or long prefill on its cluster (43.8 versus 45.1 tok/s decode; 33K prefill 37.1 versus 28.0 s). Same-creator alternative for this model and Spark count: the MTP recipe on the aidendle94 image. Licences (information only): model MIT; the upstream repository declares no licence file; vLLM Apache-2.0. Upstream figures (43.8 tok/s, 79 to 85 percent MTP acceptance) are claims until measured here; Vonk physical two-Spark acceptance is pending. Memory follows the creator's settings: gpu-memory-utilization 0.825 with no explicit KV pool, as in tonyd2wild's recipe/deepseek4-flash-fp8-mtp-vllm-sparkfix.yaml at 050f1ba3 (line 16). The steady per-node peak is 0.825 x 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus 8 GB for CUDA context, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers (a speculative draft is profiled inside the utilization budget); the reserve is 6 GB, and admission keeps the platform memory floor free beside the peak.
title: DeepSeek V4 Flash jasl vLLM two Sparks (tonyd2wild)
